en: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's\nadorable tail?
Humph!\pMy PIKACHU is twice as cute as\nthat one!
I just adore my SEEL!\nIt's so lovable!\pIt squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I\nhug it!
Oh, dear!\pMy SEEL is far more attractive.\nBy double, I would say.

I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!\pSo…\pDid you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?

Good!
Then listen up!\pMy favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt's…cute…lovely…smart… 
plus…amazing…you think so?…\loh yes…it's…stunning…\lkindly…love it!\pHug it…when…sleeping…warm
and cuddly…spectacular…\lravishing…\l…Oops! Look at the time!\lI kept you too long!\pThanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!
{PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER\nfrom the CHAIRMAN.

Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.\pExchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!\pDon't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.\pSo, I have no need for a BICYCLE.\pI hope you like cycling!
Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!
Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo?\nToo bad!
Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about\nPOKéMON.
Let's all listen politely to other\nTRAINERS!
If someone brags, brag right back!
Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his\nPOKéMON.\pBut the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.
